# 🌸Round 1🌸

## ❤️Power
- Always, always, **always** take  [No Scope Needed](item_823db5eb-5a24-4bac-b850-0aa34e76b4f6) round 1, it provides soo much value with insane healing to keep your tank alive; the most important member of your team early on.

## ❤️Items
- Taking  [Ammo Reserves](item_982d53aa-5ef4-493f-93e7-9e374d0ebf34) is a very nice QoL item round 1 as your attack speed will be so high you will be burning through ammo like nobodies business and more ammo allows you to keep your attack speed for longer!

-  [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and  [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf)  just to use your remaining cash.


## ❤️Playstyle
- Stand back, spam unscoped shots into your tank if you can (pray its not a skinny JQ youre trying to hit), make them unkillable and use the attack speed to throw some pot shots at the enemy tank if you can.

- Your main target for healing is the tank since you can keep them alive really well combined with your nade and they allow you to use your power most effectively, this lets your other support focus on keeping your dps alive.

- Surprisingly, if you have your attack speed ramped, you *can* run onto point and dps the enemy tank down by catching them off guard with your high damage. Risky but can definitely be done. Would only recommend doing it if your tank is dead or the enemy team is falling apart and you won't be heavily punished for bad positioning. Even easier if your other support notices and heals you through your aggressive play!

- Otherwise, stay safe, keep your team(tank) up, win the round.

# 🌸Round 2🌸

## ❤️Items
- Pick up  [Potent Projectiles](item_7e9a8017-9458-4318-aea9-5e80ba7e3c46) as it will help hitting unscoped shots way easier.
- If you can, pick up  [Dash Boots](item_1ec670c7-a465-4ca0-9d16-aeeedab7894e) to make sure you never die, Ana with a dash!

## ❤️Optional
- Depending on how much cash you earnt, you can keep or sell  [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) to be able to buy your rares.

- Can pick up  [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) if you have cash to spare after your main 2 rares.

## ❤️Playstyle
- Largely same as last round, but with the new mobility from  [Dash Boots](item_1ec670c7-a465-4ca0-9d16-aeeedab7894e) you could take a bit more of an aggressive approach since you now have a way to get to safety.

round_upgrades.notes: Can sell if you need the cash for the rares.

notes:
# 🌸Round 3🌸

## ❤️Power
- You want to pick up one of the **nano** powers here to make use of your fast ult generation

-  [My Turn](item_5cea2ccb-c889-4447-8a84-c704c1da1521) is the go-to since it allows you to pump out even more healing and damage, and it also makes you really hard to kill so you can use your nano defensively on yourself.

- Can take  [Our Turn](item_6e0fdb41-c00f-41d9-8ec2-1246b34a539a) if you really dont trust yourself to be useful when nano'd but it won't be as effective (yet..)

## ❤️Items
- Pick up  [Tranquilizer](item_2bea20a0-21c0-4a52-b81e-596c17d184b4) here as it's a core part of our build, selling all the other filler items if need be.

- Pick up whatever else your cash allows.

## ❤️Optional
- Depending on how much cash you have left, you can keep  [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) or buy  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e).

-  [I.V. Drip](item_4993e9c9-738f-4aba-bfbf-c6247ff71af1) is good if you need the extra survivability.

## ❤️Playstyle
- Here's where the fun begins,  [Tranquilizer](item_2bea20a0-21c0-4a52-b81e-596c17d184b4) allows you to hit basically *any* sleep you throw out which is really annoying for the enemy team.

A few case scenarios for what to focus on sleeping:
- If the enemy has a mercy, focus on denying her rezzes by sleeping her.
- If you're getting flanked a lot, you can sleep them much easier now and deny them value.
- If the enemy has an oppressive backline (Ashe, Cass) you can sleep them cross-map and set them up for death
- If all else fails, sleeping and nading the enemy tank is free value.

- Combining the movement from  [Dash Boots](item_1ec670c7-a465-4ca0-9d16-aeeedab7894e) with  [Tranquilizer](item_2bea20a0-21c0-4a52-b81e-596c17d184b4) you can be a bit more aggressive; dashing *into* enemies to sleep them - past a sig shield for example.

- Overall, same as before, focus on keeping your tank up and pumping out nanos while being a menace with your fat sleep dart!

# 🌸Round 4🌸

## ❤️Items
- If you haven't already, pick up  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) for extra healing.

-  [Stockpile](item_a113eb56-9999-4f22-9bd7-18f4dbd00cc2) is good here for the extra ammo, compensating for your fast attack speed.

- Once again, buy what you can afford;  [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) is a good choice.

## ❤️Optional
-  [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) is good if youre **really** rich (MVP Bonus anyone?)

-  [Shieldbuster](item_9ee1f150-537d-40b9-b975-7820fb1c6a66) can be taken as an alternative to  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) if you want to play more aggressively; helps in shredding tanks specifically. 

## ❤️Playstyle
- Same as last round, not much has changed besides you being better at what you already do! Can be more aggressive with your dash sleeps as your slightly higher damage means better chance at killing your sleeping victim!

# 🌸Round 5🌸

## ❤️Powers
- Here we take the other **nano** power we didn't take before, generally it's going to be  [Our Turn](item_6e0fdb41-c00f-41d9-8ec2-1246b34a539a) 

- Alternatively, if you don't want to nano your whole team for whatever reason, can also pick up  [Time Out](item_34fc2f6c-ecd9-489e-98ca-d08f3eb2fac1) for better safety against flankers and better offensive nades or  [Home Remedy](item_de68ba66-26d5-4136-a0c1-6396d3f1b0c7) which is good against ults like grav and blade.

## ❤️Items
-  [Eye of Horus](item_169551ce-e4e5-4a14-9ec4-abdc25673939) is our best friend here when combined with  [Our Turn](item_6e0fdb41-c00f-41d9-8ec2-1246b34a539a)  allowing a team wide nano anywhere on the map; pick this up 100% if you take the power.

-  [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) provides alot of extra healing on targets that are critical, an excellent choice for a support such as yourself! Sell  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) and  [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) to afford this if possible.

- Otherwise, buy what you can. If you can't afford  [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) you can keep the blues from previous rounds like  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) .

# ❤️Gameplan
- Now you become the almighty operator of teamfights, build up **nano** super fast with your insane healing and then ult your whole team for free fight wins!

- Your high  [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and  [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) combined with  [Tranquilizer](item_2bea20a0-21c0-4a52-b81e-596c17d184b4) means you can take duels if you want to — since you can sleep and burst squishy targets with your fast, hard shooting — but focusing on healing your team will probably be your best bet at building fast nanos.

# 🌸Round 6🌸

## ❤️Items
- Upgrade  [Stockpile](item_a113eb56-9999-4f22-9bd7-18f4dbd00cc2) to  [Commander's Clip](item_ff7cad01-2065-4908-a2c1-3bdf1458c7a4) to keep your healing uptime higher.

- Buy  [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) if you haven't already.

- Otherwise, build remains the same

## ❤️Optional
- If you're struggling to survive, could opt to pick up  [Overdrive Core](item_a2a8dba1-5f2f-4da1-9445-b08f49162121) instead.

## ❤️Playstyle
- Same as previous round, build nano, win teamfights.

- Can take duels and play more aggressive if you feel confident!

# 🌸Round 7🌸

## ❤️Powers
- Pick up  [Sleep Regimen](item_28934e4f-0668-482e-b10d-a5d557cc3b1e) to get a bunch of bonus health from all the sleeps you've hit in the previous rounds.

## ❤️Items
- Could keep the build the same or sell  [Dash Boots](item_1ec670c7-a465-4ca0-9d16-aeeedab7894e) in favour of  [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b) since the survivability from  [Sleep Regimen](item_28934e4f-0668-482e-b10d-a5d557cc3b1e) will keep us alive, making the dash less important.

- Could also sell  [Commander's Clip](item_ff7cad01-2065-4908-a2c1-3bdf1458c7a4) for more  [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) like  [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b) if you can't win duels due to not reaching health breakpoints or you feel like youre attacking TOO fast. Just your preference really!

## ❤️Playstyle
- Can be a more aggressive due to your bigger healthpool now if youre confident!

- Otherwise, play as you have been in the previous rounds.


Hope you win the final round! ❤️
